subject.title: Feature: trustedWebhooks for Discord — allow specific webhooks to trigger agent responses

question: Should Discord support guild-scoped trusted inbound webhook IDs that bypass the default bot-message drop, and may those webhook messages be mapped onto a configured Discord user identity?
rationale: The request is narrower than `allowBots: true`, but it creates a new inbound authority surface and the proposed `mapToUser` behavior crosses authorization and session-identity boundaries.

options.title: Approve allowlist without user mapping
options.body: Allow selected Discord webhook IDs to pass the bot-message gate while preserving webhook/bot sender identity until a separate mapping contract is approved.

options.title: Approve webhook-to-user mapping
options.body: Permit `mapToUser` only with strict validation against configured guild users, explicit audit behavior, and tests proving it cannot bypass sender authorization or session isolation.

options.title: Decline Discord-specific trusted ingress
options.body: Keep Discord bot-message policy unchanged and direct external automation to `allowBots: "mentions"`, the generic webhooks plugin, or a separate integration path.

recommendation.title: Approve allowlist without user mapping
recommendation.body: Allow selected Discord webhook IDs to pass the bot-message gate while preserving webhook/bot sender identity until a separate mapping contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work on Discord webhook/PluralKit identity makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the security-boundary decision.
